The '''Raid on Supply Depot Thrago''' was a ploy by [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] to start a war between [[The Colony]] and the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]]. The six [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] launched a preemptive strike to push the Chiss to war to stop Jacen's vision from coming to pass. The Jedi damaged the fuel and guns on the depot, and Jacen attempted a risky maneuver that nearly killed 100 Chiss. After the raid [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] vowed never to fly with her brother again. After the raid the Chiss launched an attack on [[Snevu]] and the [[Swarm War]] had begun.
